recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not restore the older TLS 1.2 deprecation/protocol-version prose for FHIR-17242; if more detailed TLS protocol guidance is desired, it should be handled as a fresh Security WG decision against the current IETF BCP 195.
issue_request: FHIR-17242 was a Published FHIR-core Security change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for STU3, asking the Security page/checklist to recommend IETF BCP 195 when TLS is used and to warn that future FHIR revisions would likely deprecate TLS versions before TLS 1.2.
initial_application: Commit 95ee245e72 applied a Security narrative update that added the BCP 195 recommendation and explanatory TLS-version guidance to source/security.html. The safety checklist later included the same recommendation in source/safety.html, and source/codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml now includes the active use-tls-per-bcp195 concept.
additional_context: FHIR-33937 is a later Published Security decision for the same paragraph. Its Jira comments and resolution recognized that BCP 195 had changed and favored keeping the BCP 195 reference while deleting stale restated TLS-version details so FHIR would not need to track changing IETF BCP text.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The latest combined branch contains the BCP 195 recommendation in source/security.html, source/safety.html, and the active safety-entries CodeSystem source, and it correctly omits the superseded TLS 1.2/lower-version restatement.
